notes.title: CRASHING FIXED I THINK FOR REAL THIS TIME!!!!!!

ON [b][i][u]SOME[/u][/i][/b] COMPUTERS!!!! Oh, and it's untraceable.  Matter of fact, for a while I thought this must be a massiove troll attempt because for a long time I couldn't find anyone willing to help me repliate it or anything. Just people claiming it happens but not helping me at all because it takes like 15 minutes of thier time to replicate and they undertsandbly [b]don't want to do that[/b]. And you know what's worse? It doesn't happen on specific hardwares. It just. [u]Happens[/u]. So while we've been triying to find a fix it's just been lowering my review ratings slowly while i sit here [i]HELPLESS [/i]and WATCH. Every time  I thought we had a lead it turned out to be a [b]dead[/b]. [b]end[/b]. I had to launch and redact like 2 updates thinking I finally found the fix. But no. We checked EVERYHTING. Archer looked at [u]Every. Single. For() loop.[/u] In the entire game, thinking one of them must be broken, right?? You know, since it's just a  random freeze with no crash logs or log notes, right?? It's gotta be a for() or while() loop error? Or perhaps it's a memory leak or something, right? But no. No. No. No. [i]NO!!!!!!!![/i] After all this time I [b]think[/b] we found the solution and you know what it is? A damn [u]DRIVER ISSUE[/u]. [i]Graphicss[/i]. F*cking. [i]Drivers[/i]. [b][i][u]GRAPHCIS DRIVERSS!?????!?!!![/u][/i][/b] NVIDIA!???: DAMN YOU!!!!!!!! DAMN YOU NVIDIA!!!!!!!!  YOUR TELLING ME THIS WHOLE TIME IT WASN"T EVEN OUR FAULT????? [i]I'VE BEEN RUNNING AROUDN THINKING I WAS A BAD DEVELOPER AND IT WAS REALLY NVIDIA[/i]??!!??![b]AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, I tried to simplify the reflection probes to accommodate for the earlier mentioned graphics driver issues, and we haven't been able to replicate the issue since on not 1 but 2 computers. I think it's safe to say the crashing is probably fixed now! Hopefully. If a [b]single[/b] one of you updates their game to [u]1.2.4[/u] and tells it's STILL crashing, [b][u]I'm just gonna have to kill myself[/u][/b]. 

Bye I'm the manliestdev here's my [url="https://discord.gg/MUHDYKzsEA"]discord [/url]and here's my [url="https://manliest.dev/"]website[/url].[/p]

notes.title: Added optional checkpoints!
notes.content:
[b]You guys spoke and we [u]listened[/u]. 
[/b]
Everyone [i]begged [/i]us for checkpoints and to make the game easier - so we added them to make the game easier. 

Normally I wouldn't do this, but I just [i]looooooove[/i] my fans so damn much that I couldn't help it! That and the [i]25% refund rate[/i], mostly from people complaining it was "[i]too hard[/i]". Even though I thought this game had a pretty typical rage game difficulty curve (Barring certain other games I haven't played that you all for some reason think I've been trying to copy or something). So whatever. Enjoy your checkpoints!

Of course, there are some drawbacks though. 
Turning on checkpoints means you can't upload to the leaderboard, and you can't get the final hat and boulder skin. Also there is a Steam achievement just for beating the game without checkpoints, so there are still some rewards for those of you who prefer to play hardcore!

Also we fixed some bugs. 
Here are the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Added an optional checkpoint system.
[*] Removed a sawblade near the giant spinner. It was made to make the game possible for 1 person but apparently it's possible regardless. Thank you Crevette for proving that.
[*] Final slope can now be beat by 1 player.
[*] Fixed bug where dev screens would stay upon unpause and pause again.
[*] Undopplered some stuff.
[*] Vsync [i]should[/i] save now.
[/list] 

As usual, enjoy. And feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/GBvW2b7Ba7]Manliest Discord[/url] if you wanna chill with the dev/other players or you just have a bug to report, we respond there much faster.

Thanks.
-ManliestDev
